'''Bob Hudsol''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as a [[sector commander]] and [[general]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. Hudsol was [[Death|killed]] when his [[Bob Hudsol's starship|starship]] was destroyed during the [[Battle of Mako-Ta|assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks]].

==Biography==
Bob Hudsol<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> was a [[sector commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> When the Alliance attacked the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]] in the [[Battle of Yavin]], Hudsol monitored the attack from the Rebel strategy center in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. After the Death Star was successfully destroyed, Hudsol attended an award ceremony in the temple where the [[pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] received medals.<ref name="ANH" /> As soon as the ceremony ended the Rebels rushed to [[Evacuation of Yavin 4|evacuate Yavin]].<ref name="L1">[[Princess Leia 1|''Princess Leia'' 1]]</ref>

[[File:Bob_Hudsol.png|thumb|left|150px|Bob Hudsol in the war room.]]
After a failed attempt to persuade [[Regent]] [[Dors Urtya]] of [[Mon Cala]] to join the Rebel Alliance, Hudsol served as a [[general]] and was present at an [[Alliance High Command]] meeting during which [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] detailed a plan to rescue [[King of Mon Cala|King]] [[Lee-Char]] in order to sway the [[Mon Calamari]] to join the rebel cause.<ref name="Star Wars 45" /> As the fleet assembled at the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]], Hudsol's [[Bob Hudsol's starship|ship]] was the first one completely outfitted and the first to pass through tests. During the [[Battle of Mako-Ta|assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks]] by the Empire's [[Death Squadron]], Hudsol was in his [[Bob Hudsol's starship|starship]] when it was destroyed and exploded in a fireball, [[Death|killing]] him.<ref name="Star Wars 53" />

==Personality and traits==
Hudsol had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, gray [[hair]], and a prominent mustache.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bob Hudsol appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ANH" /> The character did not receive a name until he appeared in [[1996]] on a card in the ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' by [[Decipher]]<ref name="TCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Rebel Commander}}</ref> Hudsol's name was confirmed to be [[canon]] in the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', which was released in [[2015]].<ref name="USW" />
Within the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', an individual resembling the Rebel bigwig, Bob Hudsol was present within the [[Great Temple]]'s [[Yavin rebel base war room|command centre]], beside the [[Holotable|holotable]], convening with [[Capin Harinar]] on his left. This individual was also present within the main hanger of the base, when [[Mon Mothma]] was departing from a location within the base, behind [[Bandwin Cor]] and unidentified senior rebel.<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

===A conceived fate===
[[Star Wars (2015)|''Star Wars'']] lead writer [[Kieron Gillen]] was the one who came up with killing off Hudsol, as he thought about how the heroes rose through the ranks so quickly.<ref name="Kieron's Tweet">{{Twitter|kierongillen|status/1083315031297703937|[[Kieron Gillen]]|quote=I did. I came from me thinking "how did our heroes climb the ranks so quickly?" and the answer being "a huge disaster which created a lot of places in CoC."|archivefile=File:KieronGillen-Death-January-10-2019.png}}</ref>
